items.title: MECH-439 clamped E3 CROSS-CANDIDATE variance-monopoly PRESENCE audit in the 936-family regime (env + per-step residue feed + P0 schedule matched to 936a), temporal partition recorded alongside, residue-protocol x warm-up 2x2
items.note: MONOPOLY-PRESENCE AUDIT IN THE 936 REGIME, routed by confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-571b_2026-09-01 sections 3 and 7 (user-ratified 2026-09-01: 936a's gate stays SHUT for the 936 regime; 571b cleared the premise for 571's regime only). 936a (clamp on, 936 regime) measured F committed share 6.33e-06 with residue_weighted at 0.99999; 571b (clamp on, 571 regime) measured harm_weighted 0.937-0.995. The two differ on THREE dimensions at once (env, per-step update_residue feeding, P0 60x200 schedule) and 571b could not apportion. This run is 936a's own ARM_OFF (canonical baseline module: 12x12/4 hazards/5 resources/reef bipartite/drift, per-step update_residue, P0 60 ep x 200 steps then P1 to 200 fresh selections, SD-056 online training, clamp ratio 2.0) measured by 571b's instrument (latch-gated fresh selections, corrected f_weighted + legacy raw-f decompositions, clamp-binding scale anchors). ROUTED DV REDESIGNED AFTER THE STEP 4.5 RED-TEAM (opus, pass 1 BLOCKING): every predecessor (571/936/936a/571b) routed on a TEMPORAL variance share -- variance across selections of a component at the committed candidate -- which is insensitive to whether a channel differentiates candidates within a tick (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-925 learning point 1, retained by 925a); the first smoke showed dispersion_to_range_ratio 229-256 in the fed arms against 571b's 0.44-3.18 band, i.e. a drifting broadcast offset dominating the temporal share. This driver routes C1/C2 on the per-tick CROSS-CANDIDATE variance partition (xcand_share: mean over P1 genuine selections of each component's within-tick variance across the candidate set, normalised to sum 1), records the temporal partitions per cell as temporal_* for comparability, and emits their disagreement (partition_disagreement: total-variation distance, top-channel-differs). Second smoke: in the fed no-warm-up cell the routed top channel is harm_weighted (0.978) while the temporal top is residue_weighted (0.9999), tv-distance 0.98 -- the partitions genuinely disagree, so C1 is no longer predetermined. Three of six declared components are structurally zero under this config (novelty hardcoded 0.0 at e3_selector.py:1295; benefit gated on record_benefit_sample() which no driver in this lineage calls; goal never seeded) -- recorded per cell with reasons, and readiness n_live_channels >= 2 self-routes a one-live-channel partition to substrate_not_ready_requeue instead of reading it as a monopoly. ARMS (2x2 inside the 936 env, matched seeds 42/43/45/46 from the lineage module -- seed 44 deliberately absent, reef per-seed instability): B1 fed+warmup (LOAD-BEARING = the 936 regime), B2 starved+warmup, B3 fed+no-warmup (the ONE OPEN contrast), B4 starved+no-warmup (571b's protocol in the 936 env; also the 571b replication). C3/C5 (fed vs starved) are WIRING CHECKS -- overdetermined by the manipulation's definition (starving removes the only write path into the residue field) -- not attribution; no gap_carrier verdict is emitted and the run does NOT claim to apportion the 936a-vs-571b gap. GRID: B1 gate red -> substrate_not_ready_requeue; B1 seeds not unanimous on the routed top channel -> seeds_disagree_on_occupant_936_regime; C1 (mean over B1 seeds of the unanimous MODAL channel's xcand share >= 0.85, deterministic tie-break) and C2 (occupant in {f_weighted, harm_weighted}) -> f_monopoly_present_936_regime (936a gate CLEARS for the 936 regime, naming the F channel); C1 and not C2 -> monopoly_present_non_f_occupant_936_regime (falsifier re-posed against the named occupant); not C1 -> no_monopoly_936_regime. Arms are matched on decomposition SAMPLE COUNT, not on env exposure or SD-056 E2 training (starved arms hold ~3x longer): per-arm tick and E2-step counts are recorded and an exposure_matching_note is emitted; occupant identity is robust to this, quantitative fed-vs-starved shares are not. residue_rbf_active_centers saturates within the first fed episode and is recorded, not headlined (first-saturation episode and the residue channel's cross-candidate share are the headline residue readouts). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = xcand_top_share / xcand_top_channel in the 936 regime; no MECH-439 manifest carries a cross-candidate component partition (all four predecessors record temporal shares only; the per-candidate spread was computed and discarded at read time) -> run, with 936a's temporal reading carried as the reference point. STEP 2.5: SD-056 clamp status=implemented; MECH-439 implementation_phase v3, not v3_pending. STEP 2.5a PROBE (seed 42, 120 steps): clamp live True/2.0 on agent.e2.config; decomp exposes f, f_weighted, harm_weighted, residue_weighted; committed rollout pinned at the ceiling; FED temporal residue var 190.1 (32/32 RBF centres) vs STARVED 2.9e-07 (0/32), harm_weighted ~2e-04 both. STEP 2.5b: MECH-439 counts 14 autopsies under the reconciled predicate; NOT braked -- diagnostic on the measurement axis asking a different question (regime-dependence), per 571b's own re_derive_brake note; no ceiling hit added. STEP 2.5c recorded, not blocking (same disposition 571b applied): SD-082 (lateral_pfc_analog::compute_bias; the 936 CONFIG_FLAGS set use_lateral_pfc_analog=True; the bias enters via the score_bias kwarg composed in REEAgent.select_action, not the decomposed f/harm/residue terms at e3_selector.py:1310/1375-1383, so it can move this DV only via which candidates are committed, and disabling it would break the 936-regime parity the audit exists to establish), contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy and SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training (E1 rollout/representation quality; fix landed, validation pending). STEP 2.6: all-false / allow. SMOKE (dry run, seed 42, 4 arms, after pass-2 fixes): exit 0, 4 verdict lines, xcand residue share delta fed-vs-starved 0.93 (engagement), n_live_channels 2-3 under the relative floor, partition_coverage 0.79-0.88 (< 1: the downstream modulatory bias is an omitted additive channel, as N1 predicts), AND the modulatory shortlist engaged on 100% of fresh selections with mean size 3.9-6.0 so final_commit_by_primary_frac was 0.00-0.12 -- i.e. at toy scale C6 FAILS: the routed channels build the shortlist and the modulatory accumulator picks within it. If that holds at full scale the monopoly labels must be read as PRIMARY-STAGE (eligibility) findings, which the notes and selection_stage_note say explicitly; validate_experiments --strict OK (0 warnings after declaring the two new constants in the reusable config slice), validate_recording --strict OK. Progress: B1/B2 print ep N/100 (P0 60 + P1 cap 40), B3/B4 print ep N/40; episodes_per_run=100 is the load-bearing arm's bound. RUNTIME: 936a's 8 P0-bearing cells took 8062 s; B1/B2 8 cells ~8000 s + B3/B4 8 cells ~1200 s -> ~155 min, estimated 180. red-team (opus): pass 1 BLOCKING (temporal partition could not fail C1; DV insensitive to cross-candidate steering) -> routed DV redesigned to the cross-candidate partition; pass 2 (opus): BLOCKING on one MEASUREMENT (N1: use_modulatory_shortlist_then_modulate=True in the lineage flags means the primary score builds a shortlist and the modulatory accumulator picks within it; shortlist size/active were never persisted) -> recorded per fresh selection + per cell (modulatory_shortlist_active_frac, size_mean, final_commit_by_primary_frac) with C6 (recorded, not routing: B1 final commit decided at the primary stage >= 0.9 in every seed) and a selection_stage_note; both monopoly labels are to be read with C6. N2 CONTESTED -> partition_coverage recorded (sum of component cross-candidate variances / Var of the final score). N3 CONTESTED -> float32 quantization floor corrected in the docstring, liveness also needs routed share >= 1e-3, max_component_abs_mean recorded. N4 CONTESTED -> C4's own exposure and commitment-holding asymmetries stated with recorded n_latched. No third pass (measurement, not a causal-chain change). Dispositions: scratchpad exq571c/redteam.md
